correctness.rationale: Both partition identities are proved via maximal/minimal elements of a finite sample of witnesses/counterexamples, which exist independently of global carrier finiteness. Positive upsets justify regrouping. Structural induction gives depth-preserving elimination. For each width-w poset, an upset generated by a maximum antichain supplies persistent constant co-witness families agreeing at all arities <w, and a single depth-one formula separates them. The w=1 and k=0 boundaries are proved. Actual standard-library finite replay succeeded with 1,204,834 identity comparisons and 76,857 lower-bound checks. It is corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete constructive normal form and sharp threshold on each fixed poset improve mere low-arity observational determination and worst-case discrete reconstruction. The proof works for infinite width-finite ordered frames, gives exact depth-preserving translations across both genuinely independent modal operators, and the lower-bound construction proves that arbitrary nesting cannot beat the width. This is a natural expressive-power invariant of PINL rather than an arbitrary finite computation.
